The Registration Process

A clear, step-by-step guide to registering your One-Person Company in Suzhou — typically completed in 15–20 working days.

Five Steps to Your Company

Each step clearly divides what you need to do and what we handle for you. Follow the timeline from start to finish.

1

Name Pre-Approval

2 Working Days

You Do

  • Choose 3–5 preferred company names (Chinese + English)
  • Provide your passport copy
  • Determine your business scope

We Handle

  • Name availability check with SAMR
  • Submit pre-approval application
  • Coordinate with registration authorities
2

Foreign Investment Filing

3 Working Days

You Do

  • Prepare your personal documents
  • Provide proof of address
  • Sign authorization forms

We Handle

  • Prepare foreign investment report
  • Submit to MOFCOM/SAMR
  • Handle all government correspondence
3

Business License

5 Working Days

You Do

  • Review and sign final documents
  • Be available for any verification calls

We Handle

  • Submit complete application package
  • Follow up with approval authorities
  • Collect your business license
4

Company Seals & Bank Account

3 Working Days

You Do

  • Choose a bank for your company account
  • Appear in person for bank opening (if required)

We Handle

  • Arrange company seal (chop) engraving
  • Prepare bank account opening documents
  • Accompany you to the bank if needed
5

Tax Registration

2 Working Days

You Do

  • Provide financial contact information
  • Set up your accounting method preference

We Handle

  • Register with tax authorities
  • Set up tax reporting profile
  • Explain ongoing compliance requirements

Important Notes

  • Total timeline: 15–20 working days from document submission to completion
  • Some steps may overlap, potentially shortening the overall timeline
  • All documents must be notarized if from overseas
  • We provide a detailed document checklist during your free consultation

Which Structure is Right for You?

Compare the traditional company setup approach with the streamlined OPC path through Moon Bay.

Feature Traditional Company Setup OPC via Moon Bay
Minimum Investors 1+ (varies by structure) 1 person
Minimum Capital Varies by industry; often required No minimum
Registration Time 30–60 working days 15–20 working days
Government Paperwork You handle it yourself or hire a consultant Fully managed by our team
Bank Account Setup Separate process, additional delays Included in the package
Ongoing Support Limited or costly retainer required Community & mentorship included
Office Space Source and lease independently Co-working space provided
Industry Connections Build from scratch Immediate network access
Best For Established companies with local staff Solo entrepreneurs & early-stage startups
